name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
title: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd - 500184 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 and FY26 with consolidated PAT INR 755 crore (+36%), but supply additions are company-led (70,000 t carbon black, LFP and anode capex) and no FY27 numeric guidance was given.

capex.quote: we successfully commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry

triggers.label: Carbon black capacity 250,000 t/yr
triggers.quote: taking our total speciality carbon black capacity to 130,000 metric tons per annum and our overall carbon black capacity to 250,000 metric ton per annum

triggers.label: PAT target INR 1,100 cr by FY28
triggers.quote: We have committed to double this PAT in next three years in FY28 to INR 1,100 plus crores.

triggers.label: Phase 1 LFP capex INR 1,125 cr
triggers.quote: What will be the total capex incurred for this 40,000? Anurag Choudhary: INR 1125 crores.

triggers.label: FX hedging loss in other expenses
triggers.quote: Because of the hedging, we had to incur losses this time.

triggers.label: Net cash fell INR 392 cr to INR 122 cr
triggers.quote: the net cash declined from INR 392 crores to INR 122 crores despite record PAT

guidance.quote: We have committed to double this PAT in next three years in FY28 to INR 1,100 plus crores.
we expect to be around INR 3,000 crores of top line from this business in next 4 years
We expect to have around 85%-90% capacity utilization for our newly announced capacities for FY27.

guidance.value: 2,000 t by Q3 FY27; 40,000 t full by FY29
guidance.quote: the first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27
expected to commission in Q2 FY27, helping address a significant import dependency in India

guidance.metric: FY27 top line and bottom line
guidance.quote: current year we will see both top line and bottom-line growth

red_flags.label: Net cash down sharply, standalone borrowings up
red_flags.quote: The standalone current borrowings also rose from INR 306 crores, INR 719 crores.

red_flags.label: Other income from treasury and fair value gains
red_flags.quote: It' s a combination of all these.

red_flags.label: Management refuses FY27 numeric guidance and anode capex details

evasions.quote: In terms of numbers, these are not significantly materialistic based on volumes.
For the current year, we don't prefer to give any specific number guideline
any MOUs or LOIs which we have signed, we have NDA. We cannot disclose this now.
